top_choice_rationale: Optical lattice clocks are a mature, experimentally realized advance: Katori's magic-wavelength proposal and Ye's demonstration of 10^-18-level accuracy combined single-ion-clock accuracy with many-atom statistics, with broad impact on metrology and fundamental tests. The two-laureate allocation and the citation scope are clean, and all eight members converge on this configuration, so an award is clearly preferable to no award.
